verdict.rationale: RUN itself documents recurring automation through RUN & DONE®, which puts recurring payroll 'on autopilot', and pay is automatically deposited on payday. However, this covers only the payroll run, not user-defined recurring jobs or general workflows, and no scheduling controls are documented. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows, documented schedule configuration (frequency, triggers, editing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Put recurring payroll on autopilot with RUN & DONE®.
On payday, pay is automatically deposited in each employee’s account.
